coverage_notes.baseline_comparison: Twelve of sixteen direct pages initially accessible versus twelve of sixteen prior run; same four persistent USDA, Guam and Maine restrictions. Intermittent follow-up 403 on RI and Forgotten Harvest; neither was a new material initial coverage gap.
coverage_notes.search_limitations: Two-day search recency is imprecise; unindexed and social-only local notices may be missed. Four recurring official-source restrictions prevent complete direct confirmation. DEGRADED retained and work persisted rather than aborted.
coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Exclude historic incidents, repeats, unsubstantiated closures, planned prior-notified outages, donation drives, generic resource guides, routine promotion, opinion, recipes and generic inflation.
coverage_notes.operations: Read-only research plus exactly one GitHub heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. No approval, publication, production change, schedule change or disabling.
